facts.fact: The head of the Real Estate Publicity and Notarisation Authority says property registration applications can be submitted manually or electronically through an electronic application, with documents uploaded online.

systems.owner: Real Estate Publicity and Notarisation Authority

facts.fact: Ahram Online reports the Real Estate Registration and Notarization Authority's New Alamein office, linked by a G2G digital hub to the New Urban Communities Authority, lets all text, digital, spatial and licensing data on land and units in the new communities be retrieved under Law 177 of 2022.
facts.system: Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority G2G integration

systems.system: Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority G2G integration

note: Online notary services (powers of attorney, lookups, booking) are stated; no land register or title search online is stated.

facts.fact: On 17 July 2025 Prime Minister Madbouly inaugurated the Real Estate Registry and Notarization Complex in New Alamein, launching a G2G integration system between the Justice Ministry's Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority and the New Urban Communities Authority in 16 real estate registry offices in new cities, enabling retrieval of text, digital, spatial and licensing data on land, properties and units.
facts.system: Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority / New Urban Communities Authority integration system

systems.system: Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority / New Urban Communities Authority integration system
systems.tiers: 16 real estate registry offices in new urban communities

facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Justice says it has launched a network linking the Real Estate Registry with the communications, planning, housing and awqaf ministries and the survey bodies, with an electronic audit centre, for property registration.
facts.system: Real Estate Registry network and unified digital platform

facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice says a unified digital platform lets a citizen complete the whole property registration cycle remotely, from application to payment and e-signature.
facts.system: Real Estate Registry network and unified digital platform

systems.system: Real Estate Registry network and unified digital platform
systems.platform: unified digital platform with electronic audit centre

note: The document states nothing this study asks for Egypt.
